content:
Elaine CS: Quick sync 3 Peregrine cutover plan: we need final quota gating, billing window, and an ops-ready load playbook. Can operations confirm runway?
Sam SRE: I can own load runs. Need exact traffic mix (chat vs. completion), token-per-request estimates, and KMS freeze window. Also will set up canary routing at 10% first 30m.
Marcus SE: Traffic profile attached (will post link to GCS). Mix: 70% short-chat (avg 35 tokens), 20% long-complete (avg 220 tokens), 10% embeddings. Cost estimate ~45k tokens/min at peak. They requested reserved pool=8 GPUs, with headroom for autoscale to 14.
Deepak Runtime: Runtime constraints: with q4_0 quant and batching, expected p50 ~ 30-60ms for short-chat on p4. Long completes push p95. Recommend autoscale policy: cpu-health+latency hybrid, min=5, max=14, scale-up ramp=60s, scale-down=180s. Also add cache-priming step.
Elaine CS: Renewal note: customer will re-evaluate if p95>350ms during first week post-cutover. Capture that in the handoff to AMs.
Sam SRE: Proposed test matrix:
- Smoke: priming 15m at 20% steady
- Soak: 2h at 70% steady
- Burst: 4x10m spikes to 3x steady within 6h window
- Chaos: kill one GPU during soak to validate fallback routing
I'll script these and post artifacts.
Marcus SE: I'll request Peregrine to whitelist test IPs and confirm KMS rotation can't occur during the 2h soak.
Deepak Runtime: Here's a minimal trigger command for CS to run priming (set TOKEN):
```
./tools/load-play --profile peregrine_chat.json --target-qps 120 --duration 900 --auth $TOKEN 
```
Marcus SE: Upload link: gs://redwood-peregrine/artifacts/traffic-profile-v3.jsonl (will set ACL for anna@peregrine).
ops-bot: Job created: "peregrine-cutover-dryrun" scheduled 2024-05-07T07:00:00Z owner Sam SRE
Sam SRE: I'll run dry-run on staging tomorrow 18:00 PT, will attach grafana links and the k8s rollout plan.
Elaine CS: Can we gate billing change until post-soak signoff? Finance prefers a 7-day invoice hold.
Marcus SE: Noted. Adding note to the CF: quota bump only after soak pass and SLA confirmation.
Deepak Runtime: Fallback config: route to gpt-medium-quant if error-rate>0.75% or p95>480ms for 5m. Will prepare automated rollback hook.
Elaine CS: Ok team. Reconvene Mon 10:30 PT for final greenlight. Action items: Sam->load scripts, Marcus->traffic file & KMS confirmation, Deepak->autoscale/fallback params, Elaine->billing hold.
All: ack :thumbsup:"
